wave10_remaining_gaps.message: This gate reads recorded provider evidence and does not start or probe SearXNG/YaCy containers.
The benchmark fixture uses deterministic vectors and does not prove production embedding relevance quality.
Unified vector object schema, embedding provenance, and main search evidence contract remain CURRENT_DEV work.

gate_semantics.live_probe_failures_are: reported as readiness gaps unless recorded contract evidence is missing or malformed
gate_semantics.status_passed_does_not_mean: live provider quality, provider=auto promotion, semantic embedding quality, or OSS node SLA closure
gate_semantics.status_passed_means: required recorded contracts and report shape are valid

unsupported_claims.claim: SearXNG and YaCy can be promoted into provider=auto.
unsupported_claims.reason: The accepted contract still keeps local open-search providers explicit-only pending quality, timeout, approval-gate, and operator policy evidence.
unsupported_claims.required_next_evidence: A separate provider=auto rollout gate with live success rate, latency, timeout, and review policy thresholds.

unsupported_claims.claim: Current SearXNG and YaCy live provider quality is proven.
unsupported_claims.reason: Wave12 only records current probe status without starting containers: {'searxng': 'unavailable', 'yacy': 'unavailable'}.
unsupported_claims.required_next_evidence: Fresh container replay with result quality assertions and zero trace failures.

unsupported_claims.claim: Current keyword/vector/hybrid local-index quality is fully proven.
unsupported_claims.reason: Wave12 mode probes are bounded local readiness checks, not production corpus relevance tests: {'keyword': 'blocked', 'vector': 'blocked', 'hybrid': 'blocked'}.
unsupported_claims.required_next_evidence: Production-like corpus benchmark with embedding provenance, ranking relevance, and fallback-rate thresholds.

unsupported_claims.claim: Deterministic vector fixtures prove production embedding semantic quality.
unsupported_claims.reason: Wave8/Wave10 fixtures prove adapter wiring, mode routing, filter behavior, and trace visibility only.
unsupported_claims.required_next_evidence: Embedding model/version contract and human-reviewable relevance benchmark.

unsupported_claims.claim: OSS node platform IO can consume search/vector outputs as a live SLA-backed primitive.
unsupported_claims.reason: Node IO can consume explicit trace fields, but live provider readiness and global vector object provenance remain partial.
unsupported_claims.required_next_evidence: Node-level IO contract replay that includes provider live status, mode fallback metadata, and unsupported-claim propagation.
